subject: Alignment note — embedding streams, function-calls & structured outputs scope
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Martin <alex.m@starlight.ai>, Priya Sharma <p.sharma@starlight.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 7 Nov 2026 15:12:00 -0800
Subject: Alignment note — embedding streams, function-calls & structured outputs scope

Hi Alex / Priya — thanks again for the call earlier today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we’re aligned before we turn this into an execution plan.

Key pain points you shared
- Search quality: embeddings-based retrieval currently returns noisy results for clinical notes. Need reranking and more robust embedding vectors.
- Latency for patient-facing flows: streaming responses with partial answers are required to keep UX snappy.
- Structured outputs: downstream systems expect normalized JSON (diagnosis_code, confidence, snippet_offsets) rather than free text.
- Security/compliance: HIPAA constraints around PHI storage and key management.

Goals we heard
1) Implement an embeddings + rerank pipeline that improves top-5 relevancy for triage queries.
2) Expose streaming generation in the SDK so the UI can render partial answers within 300ms first-byte targets.
3) Support function-calls for retrieval augmentation (call their internal knowledge API) and enforce a strict structured JSON schema for outputs.
4) Run a 2-week technical POC to validate quality and latency on a sampled dataset.

Proposed technical scope (what Redwood will deliver for the POC)
- Embeddings: batch upload endpoint + embeddings update path; recommend 1536-d vector, and we’ll provide a reranking adapter we can run server-side.
- Reranking: lightweight re-ranker using sparse+dense features; will surface top-5 improvements and per-query diagnostics.
- Streaming SDK hooks: SSE/HTTP2 streaming bindings in the SDK (JS + Python) to emit token deltas and structured event frames.
- Function-calls: schema spec for the retrieval call and examples; SDK will support automatic detection of funcall responses and typed deserialization.
- Structured outputs: JSON schema enforcement at the model layer with fallback validation handlers.
- Deployment options: Hosted for rapid iteration, Dedicated/Private for HIPAA (we’ll outline minimal changes needed).

Attachments: redwood_sdk_changes_v1.pdf (design summary) and starlight_poc_requirements.xlsx (template for sample payloads).

Proposed timeline
- Prep (sample anonymized payloads, NDA if needed): target week of Nov 9.
- POC execution: 2 weeks — target start Nov 16, complete Nov 30 (can accelerate if we agree on smaller scope).

Open questions for you
1) Can you confirm the data subset (approx 2k-10k queries) and whether sample payloads can be anonymized?
2) Is a private deployment (VPC + KMS) a hard requirement for the POC, or would a redacted-hosted flow be acceptable to start?
3) Priority metric for success — top-5 relevancy lift, latency percentile, or developer integration velocity?

If that all looks right I’ll follow up with a short mutual action plan doc and an updated timeline. Thanks — really excited to get this moving.

—
Soojin Lee
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0192

From: Alex Martin <alex.m@starlight.ai>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Sharma <p.sharma@starlight.ai>
Date: Sat, 7 Nov 2026 17:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Alignment note — embedding streams, function-calls & structured outputs scope

Thanks Soojin — solid recap. A few clarifications from our side:

- HIPAA is a hard requirement for live PHI during the POC. We need either a private deployment or a fully redacted dataset; sending raw clinical notes to a hosted endpoint is not an option.
- We’d like to accelerate the POC if possible — is a Nov 10 start realistic if Redwood can stand up an isolated environment quickly?
- Cost sensitivity: please include a rough order-of-magnitude for the Dedicated/private setup vs hosted for the POC so our procurement team can triage.

If you can provide the mutual action plan and the compliance checklist (SOC2, HIPAA controls, KMS/HSM support) we’ll pull in legal and infra and aim to get the NDA signed early next week.

On the sample data: we can produce a redacted set by EOD Monday (Nov 9) if that helps.

Thanks — Alex
Alex Martin
VP Product, Starlight AI
alex.m@starlight.ai

Internal notes + ops constraints — tagging for transparency.

Compliance and deployment
- We can provide a Private deployment (customer VPC package) for the POC with KMS integration and HSM-backed keys; SOC2 artifacts available. Timeline for private: provisioning + network setup typically 5-7 business days if we have the network CIDR and routing details.

Technical feasibility & capacity
- Embedding ingestion: for a sample of 10k documents we expect ingestion and indexing within 24 hours on a small dedicated pool.
- Streaming: SDK-level streaming is supported; we’ll instrument first-byte timings in the POC to measure 50/95/99 latencies.
- Function-calls: we’ll provide a reference adapter to call Starlight’s internal retrieval endpoint; need API key and rate limits for planning.

Questions for Soojin/Ava
1) Ava — can you propose the minimal infra checklist we need from Starlight for the private VPC? (CIDR, VPN/Direct Connect notes, KMS ARN, contact for infra onboarding)
2) Soojin — I’ll draft the cost delta (hosted vs private) and a quick canary capacity plan.

I’ll wait for the NDA and the sample payloads; happy to join a quick infra sync if Starlight wants to run through gating items.

—

- Private POC start: Nov 10 — we’ll provision a private VPC slice and deploy the POC stack (ingestion, embeddings, reranker, streaming gateway).
- POC duration: 10 business days (Nov 10–Nov 23) focused on: embedding quality, reranking deltas, streaming latency, and structured output validation.
- Deliverables: diagnostic dashboard, per-query rerank logs, sample signed-off schemas for function-calls, and a short technical teardown doc.

Owners
- Redwood: Soojin (SE lead), Ben (infra & capacity), Ava (SDK changes & integration).
- Starlight: Alex (product sponsor), Priya (tech lead), infra@starlight.ai (network + keys).

2) Redacted sample payloads (use the template in starlight_poc_requirements.xlsx)

Next steps for us

- Ava will share the SDK change diff and a short example for streaming + function-call hooks (attachment: redwood_sdk_changes_v1.pdf).

If the Nov 10 start works I’ll send the calendar invite and the mutual action plan doc after we have the NDA.

Thanks — looking forward to running this with you.
